evidence: Carries the Mempool label and removes age-based eviction, the EXPIRY removal reason, and the entry_time index from CTxMemPool.
rationale: Removing time-based expiry permanently eliminates an incentive-incompatible eviction policy that drops mineable transactions and causes bandwidth-consuming rebroadcasts. Fleet monitoring cited in the description showed 92% of expired transactions were eventually mined, while removing the entry_time multi-index container eliminates an ordered-tree node per entry and an O(log n) tree maintenance cost on every insertion and deletion.
